database.note: DATABASE_URL takes precedence; individual PG* vars used otherwise

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check DB connectivity and print tool versions.

commands.name: stage
commands.description: Hash and stage input into /data/work/staging/<ingest_id>/. Emits report JSON.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Inspect vector or raster. Returns metadata including crs_status: ok | suspicious | missing.

commands.name: ingest-vector
commands.description: Load vector dataset into raw_<ingest_id>.<table> via ogr2ogr. Normalizes geometry (ST_MakeValid, ST_Force2D). Upserts meta.ingestions.

args.name: --src-crs
args.description: Source CRS override. Required when crs_status is missing or suspicious.

args.name: --dst-crs
args.description: Reproject to this CRS on load. Use projected CRS for metric analysis.

commands.name: ingest-raster
commands.description: Load raster into raw_<ingest_id>.<table> via raster2pgsql. Optionally reprojects with gdalwarp first.

args.name: --src-crs
args.description: Source CRS override. Required when crs_status is missing or suspicious.

args.name: --dst-crs
args.description: Reproject to this CRS before loading.

commands.name: run-sql
commands.description: Execute a SQL file with ON_ERROR_STOP=1 and search_path=analysis_<ingest_id>,raw_<ingest_id>,public.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export a PostGIS table or query to GeoPackage or GeoJSON via ogr2ogr.
examples: bin/export /data/outgoing/result.geojson --format geojson --sql "SELECT * FROM analysis_20260226174050_d9d4a9f8b2.result WHERE area_m2 > 1000"

commands.name: list-ingestions
commands.description: List all ingestions from meta.ingestions, newest first.

commands.name: describe-table
commands.description: Return column names, types, and row count for a PostGIS table.

known_behaviors.column_names_lowercased: ogr2ogr lowercases all attribute column names on ingest. Source field 'Name' becomes 'name'.
known_behaviors.analysis_schema_not_auto_created: run-sql sets search_path but does not CREATE SCHEMA. Your SQL must include: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS analysis_<ingest_id>;
